Build rules for bundle headers, objects, unit tests, and fuzz tests.

# Purpose
This Makefile fragment defines build rules for the `fd_bundle` components under feature guards. It adds header files and object files for `fd_bundle_crank`, `fd_bundle_auth`, `fd_bundle_client`, and `fd_bundle_tile`, and it enables unit tests for `test_bundle_crank` and `test_bundle_client` when the required platform features are present. When `FD_HAS_HOSTED` is set, it also defines fuzz tests for `fuzz_bundle_client` and `fuzz_bundle_auth_resp` and links them with `OPENSSL_LIBS`. The `FD_HAS_DOUBLE` and `FD_HAS_INT128` checks control which source files and tests are included in the build for the target environment.
